author: Anna  Paul
book_description: Thirteen years ago, Raul left home leaving behind not only painful memories but his childhood sweetheart, Anya too. Now fate has thrown them back together and the young lovers want to reclaim what they once shared. But their tortured past hangs between them like the sword of Damocles, threatening to tear them apart once more. Will they get a second chance at love?A journey of two people who've suffered childhood trauma, torn apart by unfortunate circumstances, yet reunited by fate.Show more
